items.title: Global tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to AI slowdown fears
items.description: Investors have reacted to possible tougher scrutiny of data centre construction and the AI industry.

items.title: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses
items.description: US media reports there are calls to replace Pete Hegseth, who also faces a possible impeachment vote, while Mark Rubio is rumoured to be eyeing a presidential run.

items.title: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
items.description: Pope Leo, who had part of a lung removed last month, will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.

items.title: Trump signs order preventing future presidents from changing Oval Office
items.description: The order comes after Trump made a series of big changes to the decor of the Oval Office and tore down the White House East Wing.

items.title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
items.description: California has historically had the largest population of people on death row in the US.

items.title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
items.description: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

items.title: Chris vs Chris: Who's running and what's at stake this New Zealand election
items.description: New Zealanders will head to the polls on 7 November to elect a new government, with rising cost of living a key concern for voters.

items.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
items.description: At least 21 flights across Europe are affected in what the UK government calls a "malicious hoax threat".

items.title: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
items.description: The interior ministry estimates 600,000 people joined protests across France, while the unions say the number was far higher.

items.title: Democratic socialist defeats incumbent Karen Bass in Los Angeles mayor's race
items.description: The results mean America's two most populous cities - New York and Los Angeles - will be led by democratic socialists.

items.title: Eight killed in series of shootings in western Turkey
items.description: Victims are found in several locations in three separate vehicles, according to local reports.

items.title: Melania Trump calls for lasting Ukraine truce as she hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials
items.description: The US first lady was credited by all for playing a key though unspecified role in the ceasefire.

items.title: Bomb hoaxes: Messages reveal how threat was passed on by air traffic control
items.description: BBC Verify has been analysing messages after flights across Europe were targeted by fake bomb threats - the second such incident this week.

items.title: Chris vs Chris: Who's running and what's at stake this New Zealand election
items.description: New Zealanders will head to the polls on 7 November to elect a new government, with rising cost of living a key concern for voters.

items.title: Was an Italian chef really fired over refusal to put pineapple on pizza?
items.description: The chef had stated that putting pineapple on pizza was "offensive to his culture".

items.title: 'I'm not a quitter': Kim Kardashian on retaking the bar exam
items.description: The All's Fair star tells the BBC she has not given up, but will be "more quiet" about her journey to become a lawyer.

items.title: Film star Ranbir Kapoor on AI, movies and fatherhood
items.description: The film star plays the leading role in a major new adaptation of the Indian epic Ramayana.

items.title: A wildfire killed their loved ones in Spain. These British families demand to know why
items.description: Nine British nationals were among the 15 people who died when fire ripped through the village of Bédar this summer.

items.title: Did a data centre revolt affect the US mid-term election results?
items.description: BBC Verify examines whether US voters were influenced by the data centre boom - and the impact anti-AI sentiment could have on the industry.

items.title: Delhi's toxic winter air is back - is the Indian capital prepared for pollution?
items.description: The Delhi government has announced a four-month winter action plan, but experts say that won't be enough.
